subject: perpendicular distance using distance and angle information

messages.author: 9ca502218c2e2949
messages.subject: perpendicular distance using distance and angle information
parts:
Hello dear all, I intend to estimate density using distance sampling data. During my field surveys, I have performed line transects and collected data of distance and angle for each cluster observation instead of perpendicular distance. When I tried to use the distance package I 've learned that I need the perpendicular distance, so I calculated using: cos (angle in radians)*distance. This it seems to be wrong because if I compared the results obtained in this way with the same data analyzed in distance software they are clearly different. 
I really would like to learn how to work with distance and angle information in the Distance package in R. Is there anything else that I should take into account to calculate perpendicular distance? 
Thank you for your time
Regards
Antonela

Try this transformation of your distance and angles; that should better match your previous analysis.
